text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-chan, thanks for the potpourri the 
other day! The scent is so gentle... 
Putting it by my bedside let me sleep so 
wonderfully.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I'm glad. I made it tailored to 
Ai-san—both the fragrance and the colors.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The color palette matches the racing 
attire. The fragrance isn't just sweet— it 
has a distinct, unmistakable—freshness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I prepared it hoping it would cheer you 
up just by having it by your side. ...I'm 
glad you like it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I... Is that so? You thought of me, and 
saw it that way...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I thought people around me just saw me 
as feisty, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, is making potpourri difficult? 
I'd... love to give some as a present too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my. That sounds lovely. It might take 
some time—but it's 
not—particularly—difficult.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
In that case... something white, and 
gentle... I want to make something that 
warms your heart just by having it close 
by.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes. It is—lovely. I am sure the 
recipient—will be very happy—with it.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. In that case, will you teach me 
how to make it? I'll pour my heart into 
crafting it."
